title: getPrices: cache lookups

spec.text: Speed up getPrices(skus) by caching prices for 60 seconds and sharing in-flight lookups, so concurrent requests for the same SKU hit the pricing service once. Failed lookups must not be cached.

context: Called by the cart and search endpoints, which zip the returned prices with the skus they passed by index. SKUs are numeric strings like "100234" and a cart may list the same SKU twice. pricing.lookup resolves to { sku, amountCents } or rejects on timeout.
